title: He Invented Infinite Scroll. Now He Regrets It. #shorts
description:
In 2006, designer Aza Raskin invented infinite scroll. Years later, he said he regretted how it was used, and estimated it wastes around 200,000 human lifetimes every single day.

The feed was never built to end. So you have to.

Follow for the dark truths nobody tells you.
